title: Syn2DRE: Synergistic Dual Teacher-Student Framework for Document-level Relation Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2611.09342v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Document-level Relation Extraction (DocRE) aims to identify relations between entities across a document but typically relies on costly large-scale annotations. While pseudo-labelling enables the use of low-quality data, existing methods often suffer from inefficiency and confirmation bias. To address these challenges, we propose Syn2DRE, a semi-supervised framework that combines self-supervised learning with cross-supervision in a lightweight teacher-student architecture to produce more reliable pseudo-labels. Additionally, we introduce a unified end-to-end training strategy to further improve efficiency of the framework. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Syn2DRE consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art semi-supervised DocRE methods.

translated_title: Syn2DRE：用于文档级关系抽取的协同双师生框架
translated_abstract: 文档级关系抽取（DocRE）旨在识别文档中实体之间的关系，但通常依赖昂贵的大规模标注。虽然伪标签技术能够利用低质量数据，但现有方法往往存在效率低下和确认偏差的问题。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了Syn2DRE，这是一个半监督框架，它在轻量级的师生架构中将自监督学习与交叉监督相结合，以产生更可靠的伪标签。此外，我们引入了统一的端到端训练策略，进一步提高了框架的效率。在多个基准测试上的实验表明，Syn2DRE始终优于之前最先进的半监督DocRE方法。
tldr: Syn2DRE提出了一种协同双师生半监督框架，通过在轻量级师生架构中结合自监督学习与交叉监督来生成更可靠的伪标签，并采用统一的端到端训练策略，在文档级关系抽取任务上取得了超越现有最先进方法的性能。
